stop: Stop after the particle sweep (stage 1) and the 100 + 100 small nuisance-SMC split (stage 2); they give the SMC accuracy-versus-cost curve and its certified-fraction / latency point for T3.
_doc: Role baselines; lineage cfcap-baselines. Replaces the held b2-smc-cal / b2-smc-test groups: the pilot2 canary measured nuisance-SMC at >= 500 s per episode on a 3090 (planned 80 s). Episodes: generator ids in 0..1999 (the models role's ids) whose parent is a 2-module chain (pair) or a 4-module grid (square), listed in results/baselines/smc_small_ids.json (test: 79 pair + all 21 square; cal: 72 pair + all 28 square). Stage 1: particle sweep 256 / 1024 / 2048 ('full') on 10 test ids (5 pair, 5 square), one episode per job. Analyse with `scripts/baselines_pilot.py smc-sweep --runs ~/.cache/vast-out`, which picks the cheapest setting within 1 pt of 2048 on truth retention and q05 coverage. Stage 2 is written at 256 particles; if the sweep picks more, edit --particles and unit_s (~ the sweep's s/episode) in both stage-2 groups and re-emit before submitting stage 2. Per-episode times are the canary's lower bound; 2048-particle jobs can run ~45 min.

groups.purpose: Particle sweep of nuisance-SMC on 10 generator test episodes (5 pair, 5 square parents): 256 particles, for the accuracy-versus-cost curve.

groups.purpose: Particle sweep of nuisance-SMC on 10 generator test episodes (5 pair, 5 square parents): 1024 particles, for the accuracy-versus-cost curve.

groups.pilot: cfcap-baselines-pilot2 bl-canary (2026-11-25, coordinator): nuisance-SMC >= 500 s per episode on a 3090 at 256 particles x <= 150 stages; 2048 particles assumed 5x
groups.purpose: Particle sweep of nuisance-SMC on 10 generator test episodes (5 pair, 5 square parents): 2048 particles, the reference full setting.
